text:
erin: heads-up from qbench on qlarge-quant2: were seeing anchor fragmentation in the golden promptset after the runtime strips punctuation in quantized tokeniser. some paraphrases now hash to different anchors, others collapse. pinging @labeling-team.
pat: can you show a minimal pair? collapse vs fragmentation?
erin: yes. collapse example: "Track order #A-321" + "Where is order A321?" -> both collapsed. fragmentation example: "Refund for item (blue)" became separate anchors when parentheses stripped in one path.
devon: ugh, two different failure modes. collapse is dangerous (losing paraphrase diversity), fragmentation is noisy (duplicates proliferate). what's the scale?
erin: qbench flagged ~3.8k collisions and ~2.1k newly fragmented anchors out of 310k bank. ~240 anchors with golden labels touched.
maya: runtime change log shows punctuation normalization toggled for quant kernels in v2.0.4. that matches timing.
label-coordinator: label ops note: if anchors fragment, golden annotations might be split and reviewers could miss context. we need a conservative plan to avoid losing gold.
pat: proposal: (1) run a targeted 'reconcile' script that maps old_anchor -> new_anchor via char-normalized and tokenized keys, (2) compute diff, (3) surface only anchors where gold label would change. keep all gold edits behind two approvals.
devon: technical note: we can compute a fallback fingerprint as stable_char_norm = lower(strip_punct(text)); rolling_hash(stable_char_norm, w=9). then compare with token-based fingerprint. if mismatch, mark for manual triage.
erin: i can add a small repro and the reconcile script to infra repo. will include dry-run flag to preview queue churn.
label-coordinator: ops please export impacted list. ops-bot?
ops-bot: export queued: `export_promptset --set prompt_gold_master --filter "anchor_delta=true" --out s3://redwood/tmp/qlarge_anchor_delta_1745.json` (jid: 9021)
maya: we should also run a short A/B: keep current fingerprinting vs add punctuation-tolerant fallback. run on 8k random sample containing flagged anchors. metrics: anchor count delta, golden-anchor hit rate, label churn.
pat: agree. if fallback reduces false merges <1% and keeps fragmentation <0.5%, consider adopting fallback with provenance tag. otherwise we re-run fingerprinting globally.
devon: running quick estimate: targeted reconcile on 310k with 8 workers ~2.2 hrs. cost trivial. full re-fingerprint ~5.5 hrs.
erin: labelers: expect some queue changes. label-coordinator says contractor pool can add 3 reviewers tomorrow 10-14 PT.
label-coordinator: confirmed. also checklist: (a) export diff, (b) open JIRA, (c) golden edits require 2 approvers, (d) backfill eval run on a held-out set.
maya: one more guardrail: when we write new fingerprint field, include provenance fields: fingerprint_algo, tokenizer_version, runtime_build. keeps snapshots reproducible.
erin: PR plan: add repro, reconcile script, A/B job config, docs for golden-change process. PR by EOD.
pat: once PR up i'll kick the A/B and share metrics here. aim to decide fallback vs global re-fingerprint by EOD tomorrow.
ops-bot: calendar invite created: "qlarge-quant2 promptset reconcile" tomorrow 10:00-13:00 PT.
erin: thanks all. updating thread as I push PR and A/B results. :thumbsup:
